changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1 with Machine Pages: the LOOPER machine, a live looper on one track, based on sumedho's RAM Machines 1.3.1.
Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; it links to the same image (LL01, 39a045c7…) as the locally compiled recipe used for the emulator checks.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
